messages.subject: findNextItem function in mirtCAT
parts:
Hello Phill,

I am sorry to bug you again.

Is there any way to use findNextItem or mirtCAT for the sake by inputting parameter matrix, responses , items administered and theta to get the next item instead of using  following code:

# test defined in mirtCAT help file, first example
CATdesign <- mirtCAT(shiny_questions, mod, item_answers=answers, criteria = 'MI',
   design_elements = TRUE)


# returns number 1 in this case, since that's the starting item
findNextItem(CATdesign)

I know that mirtCAT is one step ahead of for CAT. However, consider a scenario in which you do not have access to the questions.

What all you have is response data. So can we not calibrate the question based on the the response data and use this item parameter matrix and responses to get the next administered items.

I am talking on the similar lines of that of the "nextItem" function in catR package.

http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/catR/catR.pdf    page no. 44


Regards,
Irshad

# test defined in mirtCAT help file, first example

   design_elements = TRUE)


# returns number 1 in this case, since that's the starting item

I know that mirtCAT is one step ahead of for CAT. However, consider a scenario in which you do not have access to the questions.

What all you have is response data. So can we not calibrate the question based on the the response data and use this item parameter matrix and responses to get the next administered items.

You don't have to include the shiny_questions input if you are just doing things offline (i.e., with no GUI). By leaving the questions out numerical responses are returned instead, which sounds more like what you are looking for. Cheers.

Phil

I am talking on the similar lines of that of the "nextItem" function in catR package.
